title: Deadline and Contact
author: Orsen Kavanagh
blurb: Astrid Ravensworth, a crash investigator whose family died in row twelve, has spent twenty years following rules that keep getting rewritten. But when a voiceprint unlocks a server on another continent, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must get the truth past three governments and one assassin before the extraction flight leaves at dawn.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
